description: This PHP file defines a migration class for version 5.7.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It performs database schema modifications, language string management, and cleanup operations related to localization, permissions, and historical data migration, encapsulated within the class 'Migration' extending 'AbstractMigration'.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for database schema updates, localization cleanup, and permission management for OrangeHRM v5.7.0, extending AbstractMigration.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps: deleting language strings, updating data groups, inserting permissions, dropping old tables, and creating new schema components.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number '5.7.0' of this migration.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version field in 'ohrm_i18n_lang_string' table for entries with null version.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes translations for a given language string unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: dropOldTables
methods.description: Drops obsolete or unused database tables related to the migration.

methods.name: insertI18NError
methods.description: Inserts a new internationalization error message into the 'ohrm_i18n_error' table.

methods.name: deleteUnusedLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes language strings and translations that are no longer needed for the specified groups.
